rules.name: rrr-price-source-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT t.trade_id, t.security_id, s.derivative_type, s.underlying1_id, s.strike1, sv.settle_price AS security_settle_price, sv.created_timestamp AS security_price_loaded, u.settle_value AS underlying_value, c.settle_price AS cache_settle_price, c.created_timestamp AS cache_created FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = t.business_unit AND s.security_id = t.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table sv ON sv.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND sv.business_unit = t.business_unit AND sv.security_id = t.security_id AND sv.value_date = :valueDate LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u ON u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND u.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id AND u.value_date = :valueDate LEFT JOIN opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = t.business_unit AND c.trade_id = t.trade_id AND c.value_date = :valueDate WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND t.trade_id IN ('TR-FY-2025-539133', 'TR-FY-2025-539134', 'TR-FY-2025-539135', 'TR-FY-2025-539136', 'TR-FY-2025-539137', 'TR-FY-2025-539138', 'TR-FY-2025-539139', 'TR-FY-2025-539140') ORDER BY t.trade_id

WITH ten AS (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), j AS ( SELECT c.settle_price AS cache_p, sv.settle_price AS sec_p, u.settle_value AS und_p FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t ON t.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND t.business_unit = c.business_unit AND t.trade_id = c.trade_id AND t.is_latest_version = 1 JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = t.business_unit AND s.security_id = t.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table sv ON sv.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND sv.business_unit = t.business_unit AND sv.security_id = t.security_id AND sv.value_date = :valueDate LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u ON u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND u.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id AND u.value_date = :valueDate WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM ten) AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.value_date = :valueDate ) SELECT (sec_p IS NOT NULL) AS security_price_exists, (abs(coalesce(cache_p, 0) - coalesce(sec_p, 0)) < 0.000001) AS cache_equals_security_price, (abs(coalesce(cache_p, 0) - coalesce(und_p, 0)) < 0.000001) AS cache_equals_underlying_value, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM j GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY n_rows DESC

SELECT 'cache' AS src, MIN(created_timestamp) AS first_loaded, MAX(created_timestamp) AS last_loaded, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'security_settle_price', MIN(created_timestamp), MAX(created_timestamp), COUNT(*) FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'underlying_settle_value', MIN(created_timestamp), MAX(created_timestamp), COUNT(*) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND value_date = :valueDate
